source_refs.note: Exercise 6.6, Question 2 (book p. 215-215); answer key PDF 308-309; checked with sympy

blocks.prompt: 2. Find an equation of the parabola formed by the cables of a suspension bridge whose span is \(\ell\) m and the vertical height of the supporting towers is \(h\) m.
blocks.explanation:
Yeh Example 31 (suspension bridge) ka general roop hai: numbers ki jagah letters \(\ell\) aur \(h\) hain.
Diya kya hai? Bridge ka span (dono towers ke darmiyan poora faasla) \(\ell\) m hai, aur towers cable ke sab se neeche wale point se \(h\) m ooper tak jate hain.
Find kya karna hai? Cable ki equation.
Plan: cable ke lowest point ko origin banayenge, \(x^2 = 4ay\) lenge aur tower ki choti wala point rakh kar \(4a\) nikalenge. Letters se ghabrana nahi; tareeqa bilkul numbers wala hai.
steps:
Diya gaya: span \(\ell\) m; towers cable ke lowest point se \(h\) m ooncha.
Maloom karna: cable ki equation.
Tareeqa: origin cable ke sab se neeche wale point (vertex) par rakhte hain aur \(y\)-axis bridge ke beech mein khari (vertical) rakhte hain. Latakti hui cable ooper ki taraf khulti hai, is liye equation \(x^2 = 4ay\) ki shakal ki hogi. Vertex origin par ho to equation sab se saada hoti hai, isi liye yeh choice ki.

Tower ki choti ka point
Towers span ke dono siron par hain, har ek beech se \(\frac{\ell}{2}\) door. Is liye right tower ki choti
\[B\left(\dfrac{\ell}{2},\ h\right)\]
Kyun: span poori chaurai hai, us ka aadha \(y\)-axis ke daayen aur aadha baayen hai. Height \(h\) vertex se naapi gayi hai, aur vertex origin par hai, is liye \(y\)-coordinate seedha \(h\) hai.
Dhyan dein: \(x\)-coordinate \(\ell\) nahi, \(\frac{\ell}{2}\) hai. Poora span lena sab se aam ghalti hai.

\(4a\) nikalein
\[\left(\dfrac{\ell}{2}\right)^2 = 4a\,h\]
\[4a = \dfrac{\ell^2}{4h}\]
Kyun: point \(B\) cable par hai, is liye \(x^2 = 4ay\) ko satisfy karega. \(\left(\frac{\ell}{2}\right)^2 = \frac{\ell^2}{4}\), phir dono taraf \(h\) se divide kiya.

Cable ki equation
\[x^2 = \dfrac{\ell^2}{4h}\,y\]
\[y = \dfrac{4h}{\ell^2}x^2\]
Kyun: \(4a\) ki value \(x^2 = 4ay\) mein rakhi aur phir \(y\) ko akela kiya (cross multiply). Dono shaklein ek hi parabola hain; kitab ki answer key doosri shakal deti hai.

Tasdeeq
\[x = \pm\dfrac{\ell}{2}:\ y = \dfrac{4h}{\ell^2}\cdot\dfrac{\ell^2}{4} = h\]
\[x = 0:\ y = 0\]
Kyun: cable dono towers ki choti tak pohanchti hai aur beech mein origin par sab se neeche hai. Bilkul wohi jo sawal keh raha tha.
Dhyan dein: agar towers road se naape gaye hon aur cable road se kuch ooper ho, to \(h\) ki jagah (tower ki height minus cable ki lowest height) lena parta hai; Question 10 mein yahi hoga.
blocks.final_answer: \(y = \frac{4h}{\ell^2}x^2\) (yani \(x^2 = \frac{\ell^2}{4h}y\)); origin cable ke lowest point par.
